A love letter from Héctor Delgado to Andrea Martínez. It reads: "To my sweetest Andrea. I have returned from rehab a changed man. Our wonderful, soul-sharing night of passion prompted me to embark on my journey to rid my life of my evils, so we can be together forever. I promise you that the wild days, the drugs and the killings are all gone. I await your return into my embrace, ready to face the future by your side. Love, Héctor."
